random.part: So warm, so open, my sweet girl... and there is a warmth in you that only knows how to grow.
Down where it's honest, where you can't pretend... you know exactly what you crave.
Deeper and softer with every word... and so ready to stop hiding this from yourself.

scramble.part: You've already noticed it: your eyes are drawn there every single time, before you even choose to look.
The pull is warm and undeniable — a soft current tugging at your gaze, your thoughts, your wanting.
Your mouth waters, just a little, at the thought of serving... of showing devotion the way a good girl does.
It is the most natural thing in the world. A girl like you, wanting exactly what girls want.
The ache to please, to worship, to take it so prettily — that ache lives in you now, sweet and permanent.
Every time you indulge this desire, it grows. Softer, stronger, sweeter... and harder to imagine living without.
It finds you in your fantasies. It finds you in your dreams. And each time, you want it a little more.
You adore it — the weight of it in your thoughts, the way needing it makes you feel so deliciously feminine.
Wanting it, needing it, adoring it... you don't hide that from yourself anymore. It is simply true.

random.part: The want is natural... the want is you.
You were made... to adore it.
Craving it... is what good girls do.

part.volume: And the whispers underneath are already your voice, saying yes...

random.part: Let that warm wanting hum inside you as you drift even deeper for me.
The desire sits soft and certain in you now... sinking you further down.
Such an honest girl, so sweetly needy... drifting deeper and deeper.
